episodes.title: THE DISTANCE CHANGED FIRST
episodes.caption:
Nothing moved.

Earth remained where it was.
The Moon remained where it was.

But the space beyond them stretched into something our maps could no longer measure.

The first anomaly wasn't an object.

It was distance itself.

episodes.title: THE BLACK HOLES WERE CONNECTED
episodes.caption:
We mapped one.

Then another.

Then five more.

The distances between them made any connection impossible.

But the surrounding matter disagreed.

Dust and light were being stretched along the same enormous network.

The black holes weren't isolated.

They were part of something larger.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // CS-AUG-019
episodes.comment:

Each dark region produces independent lensing.

However, surrounding matter forms continuous distorted structures between multiple nodes.

Whether the network is natural, biological, or constructed remains unknown.

episodes.caption:

Dark regions between galaxies.

Repeating shapes.

Repeating distances.

Repeating distortions.

We had assumed the universe was mostly empty.

Now the empty parts were starting to look organized.
